title: Preserve parser-specific mailbox alias refusals through public availability checks
outcome: Healthy-directory parser errors report an actionable grammar refusal instead of a false inventory-outage diagnosis, while actual unavailable-host and incomplete-legacy checks remain fail closed.
acceptance: Public backend and MCP paths distinguish unavailable inventory from reserved, empty and known-host-prefix grammar errors without changing recipient selection.
Focused public-path controls pin the refusal status and actionable exact-id/name:/host: guidance for both healthy and unavailable directory snapshots.
